question.prompt: An item originally costs 50 yuan. After two successive price reductions, each by the same percentage, its current price is 40.5 yuan. Find the percentage of each price reduction. (Give the numerical value of the percentage; for example, write 15% as 15.)

solutions.explanation: \(50(1-x)^2=40.5\), \((1-x)^2=0.81\), \(1-x=\pm0.9\), so \(x=0.1\) or \(x=1.9\) (the rate of price reduction cannot exceed 1, so this is discarded). Therefore, each price reduction is 10%.
